samples.question: The bin on the left holds a stack of coloured blocks, bottom block at the bottom. The square cards on the right are operations, applied one at a time in order from left to right (the arrow shows the order). A card marked with a white plus adds one new block of that card's own colour on top of the stack. A grey card marked with a white minus removes the block currently on top of the stack. The final stack is not drawn. After every card has been applied, which colour is the block on top of the stack? Answer with one colour name: red, blue, green, orange, or purple.
